title: activeCallId has no authorization check on referenced VTCCall
description: SceneRegion/set update (scene-00.md line 930) allows a region owner to set activeCallId to any VTCCall id string. No validation is specified: the referenced call may not exist, may belong to a different account, may be ended, or may be a call the region owner is not a participant of. A region owner who is not a VTC moderator can bind any call they know the id of. Need: server MUST validate that the referenced VTCCall exists, is not ended, and the caller has access to it.
